input.title: Women's Hiking – Here for the View, Not the Incline Cropped Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

Here for the view, not the incline: a crop top hoodie for the woman who loves the mountains from the overlook parking lot, worn to the trailhead, the road trip and every hike she cheerfully skips.

The print is a 1970s national-park-poster illustration of a mountain overlook at golden hour: a red station wagon with its tailgate open beside a folding camp chair holding a thermos and a paper map, a stair-stepped trail climbing the hillside behind it, pines and a quiet lake below. HERE FOR THE VIEW. runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and NOT THE INCLINE. closes the print along the bottom.

Wear it to the scenic overlook, the campground coffee line or any hike where you are the one with the folding chair, or give it to the sister or best friend who owns all the gear and skips the climb. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Women's cropped hoodie, dropped shoulder cut, cropped body with a raw hem
  • 52% airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, 48% poly fleece
  • Fabric weight: 6.5 oz/yd²
  • Dyed-to-match drawstrings
  • Sizes S–2XL
  • Color: Storm
  • Blank product sourced from Mexico, Nicaragua or the United States

Questions

What is the Here for the View, Not the Incline hoodie?
It is a women's cropped hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. printed with a 1970s park-poster overlook and the words HERE FOR THE VIEW. NOT THE INCLINE. It is a Bella+Canvas 7502 with a cropped body, raw hem and dropped shoulders, made from soft 6.5 oz cotton-poly fleece.

How does the cropped fit run?
The Graphic Tees Co. cropped hoodie has a dropped shoulder cut and a cropped body with a raw hem, so it sits at the waist or just above it. Order your usual size for the cropped look, or size up one for a roomier fit over a long tank. Sizes run S through 2XL.

How do I wash it so the print lasts?
Wash your Here for the View, Not the Incline hoodie inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. The fabric is 52% combed ring-spun cotton and 48% polyester fleece at 6.5 oz, and the cream, mustard and sage inks stay crisp through every wash from the trailhead to the laundry room.

Is it a good gift for a hiking friend?
Yes. At $44.99 from Graphic Tees Co. it suits the sister, best friend or mom who loves the mountains and the snacks more than the miles, and it works for birthdays and Christmas. Your first size exchange is free, so a wrong guess on size costs nothing.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Here for the View, Not the Incline hoodie should arrive before Christmas. Each hoodie is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and your first size exchange is free.
